name: Grok 1
notes: PARAMS: 314B is xAI's own stated figure. ACTIVE IS NULL AND DELIBERATELY SO: neither the model card nor run.py states an active-parameter count. 314B total with 8 experts and 2 selected per token implies roughly 314/8 plus attention and embeddings, but deriving an active count that way assumes perfectly uniform experts and that the attention tower is 1/8 of the model, and xAI does not publish it. Leaving it null rather than guessing. KV: 64 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 262,144 bytes/token = 256 KiB/token, derived from run.py's num_layers=64, num_kv_heads=8 and key_size=128 (emb_size 48*128 = 6144). CONTEXT IS 8192, which is the headline serving fact: at 128k-era context lengths this model is not deployable at all. 8k on 256 KiB/token is 2 GiB of KV per sequence. WEIGHTS ARE NOT SAFETENSORS. xai-org/grok-1 ships int8 quantized custom ckpt-* shards and has NO config.json; every architecture field here comes from the JAX reference implementation in run.py plus the model card's specification list, cross-checked against each other. The reference MoE layer is explicitly described by xAI as not efficient (chosen to avoid custom kernels). Grok 2 and later, and the Grok Diffusion diffusion LM, are NOT recorded here: their weights were not retrievable in this session.
